## v3.3: fire braziers — warm light sources so night is showcase-able and the
## day/night cycle reads. Fires also double as a lighting exhibit.
func _build_fires() -> void:
	var spots: Array = []
	for i in range(8):  ## ring of braziers just outside the plaza edge
		var ang := TAU * float(i) / 8.0
		spots.append(Vector3(sin(ang) * 15.8, 0, cos(ang) * 15.8))
	## a few out on the hills so the far field isn't a black void
	spots.append(Vector3(22, 0, -14))
	spots.append(Vector3(-21, 0, 17))
	spots.append(Vector3(13, 0, 24))
	spots.append(Vector3(-24, 0, -9))
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = SCATTER_SEED + 1
	for spot in spots:
		var p: Vector3 = spot
		p.y = terrain_height(p.x, p.z)
		var stand := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
		cyl.top_radius = 0.18
		cyl.bottom_radius = 0.30
		cyl.height = 1.0
		stand.mesh = cyl
		stand.position = p + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
		var sm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		sm.albedo_color = Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.06)
		sm.roughness = 0.9
		stand.material_override = sm
		add_child(stand)
		var ember := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var sph := SphereMesh.new()
		sph.radius = 0.16
		sph.height = 0.32
		ember.mesh = sph
		ember.position = p + Vector3(0, 1.05, 0)
		var em := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		em.emission_enabled = true
		em.emission = Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2)
		em.emission_energy_multiplier = 4.0
		em.albedo_color = Color(0.2, 0.1, 0.02)
		ember.material_override = em
		add_child(ember)
		var light := OmniLight3D.new()
		light.position = p + Vector3(0, 1.4, 0)
		light.omni_range = 13.0
		light.light_energy = 2.4
		light.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.32)
		light.shadow_enabled = false  ## many shadow-casting omnis = perf hit on this GPU
		add_child(light)
		fire_lights.append([light, 2.4, rng.randf_range(4.5, 8.0), rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)])
		var body := StaticBody3D.new()
		body.collision_layer = 2
		body.position = p + Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
		add_child(body)
		var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
		var sc := CylinderShape3D.new()
		sc.radius = 0.35
		sc.height = 1.0
		col.shape = sc
		body.add_child(col)
	print("[showcase] fires lit: ", fire_lights.size())
